title: Docs portal: doc-to-doc links render href="/docs/NAME" without the /_console base, so open-in-new-tab or a copied link answers 404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND
body:
**Filing gate ①**: a user-visible product defect with a named landing and a reproduction. Reach: the console docs portal. Open-in-new-tab or a copied link answers 404.

**Reader who acts:** the objectui docs/console lane seat owning the docs-portal body renderer. It must resolve doc-to-doc links through the router basename, the same remedy as closed #12233.

## What

Links between docs inside a rendered doc body carry `href="/docs/NAME"` with no `/_console` base. An in-app click works, because the client router intercepts it. Open-in-new-tab, middle-click or a copied link sends the browser to the server path `/docs/NAME`, which answers **404 `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`**.

## Reproduction

1. objectstack `main` `94114c1f` showcase, with the vendored console at pin `daeb77fc`, signed in as admin.
2. Open the docs portal in the console and pick any doc whose body links to another doc.
3. Inspect the link:
   - expected: `href="/_console/docs/NAME"`, or whatever the router basename resolves to;
   - actual: `href="/docs/NAME"`.
4. Open that link in a new tab → 404 `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, closed included: `docs link href missing _console base path new tab 404` → 20 hits. The closest is #12233 (closed), the same class on record-page lookup links; the others are #11769, #4181 and #2638 (all closed, other surfaces). None covers docs-body links.

QA-source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23939 · platform-core.docs-portal-render · observation
